summary: Build manifest for the Gemini enablement program under 1B (three-phase), 2B (End+disable the Warden while idle, six-slot series with daemons disabled, restart through a reviewed retarget) and 3B (identity = the model name the CLI echoes must equal the model the controller passed; mismatch or absence fails; no tier restriction). The three designs were merged into 16 components across Phase A (sitting 1: stop, discovery capture, six Google sign-ins, logged-in capture, isolation + model-form matrix, restore on r4), Phase B (agent-only: the four-file source change, r5 freeze/installer, r5 config builder/staging, upgrade-preview, orchestrator Phase C, second review) and Phase C (sitting 2: install r5 stopped, preview, stop, stage config, retarget to r5, acceptance preflight). Decisive verification done this session: `agy.exe --output-format json models` (flag BEFORE the subcommand) returns a JSON envelope with status SUCCESS and command.name 'models' (capture sha 1613d351...), which settles the subscription-probe protocol as json-fields and refutes the deployment designer's 'models prints no JSON'; the catalog exposes only effort-suffixed slugs (no 'gemini-3.8-flash', no 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview'); every downstream consumer (probes.py:527, :788-789; preflight.py:86; store/queue_launch/coding_store/reconciliation) requires gemini receipt.reported_model == the ROUTED canonical model, so routing tiers stay unchanged and a reviewed per-(model,effort) model_bindings table carries the CLI slug (the source designer's design), amended only by the A5 capture; the baseline of the ten touched test files is 712 passed / 3 skipped (26.87 s); every r4 pin and the live r4-v1 task action were re-hashed on disk. The single 50-minute sitting is not achievable: the r5 contract values (subscription_probe, capability_reference, model_bindings/effort_contracts form, isolation attestations) come from sitting-1 receipts and need a second review round, so the honest plan is two sittings (about 38 min wall / about 17 min attended, then about 23 min wall / 0 attended). Baseline agent effort about 184 h (about 23 agent-days) excluding the conditional launcher contingency (16 h) and live sitting support. Highest-uncertainty item: whether agy 1.3.1 under launch_worker (CREATE_NO_WINDOW, no CONIN$, stdin pipe) reaches the authorization-URL + pasted-code path at all; the A2 capture answers it before any attended step and the series stops with evidence (and restores r4) if it does not.
